published_prior_art.cite: TianWu2025 gives regular point-PN EIF inference; CuellarKennedy2020 gives regular nonparametric PC confidence intervals, not rare-count uniform inference.
TianWu2025 derives the monotone-PN efficient influence function and regular efficient limit.
McGrathBurke2024 studies rare-binomial interval coverage and width; the guarded-score specialization is not covered, but the conservative bound is not a sharp frontier advance.
GleserHwang1987 concerns infinite expected diameter in zero-information ratio models, not the bounded rare-PN rate frontier.
GleserHwang1987 supplies a general expected-diameter impossibility template; the bounded monotone-PN two-point specialization is not stated there.
Huwang1995 establishes non-uniformity of an approximate binomial interval; the displayed multinomial Poisson limit is a routine rare-cell specialization.
MikushevaSun2022 develops weak-IV test inversion, not learned rare-event PN marked-Poisson calibration.

novelty_flags.label: Theorem uniform coverage / related work
novelty_flags.one_line: The survey omits CuellarKennedy2020, a close published probability-of-causation paper with nonparametric estimation and valid confidence intervals; distinguish its projected conditional-PC target and regular regime from the proposed marginal rare-PN regime.

novelty_flags.label: Open-ended Question sharp diameter frontier
novelty_flags.one_line: It asks whether an unspecified honest confidence set attains a rate, without naming a candidate inversion or construction route beyond the existing guarded set.

soundness_flags.label: ass:score-nondegeneracy
soundness_flags.one_line: The rare-array condition inf_t v_{t,n}/d_n >= c_v is not the fixed-scale variance-nondegeneracy condition supported by ChernozhukovEtAl2018DML; retag it novel and justify the d_n normalization, or cite a triangular-array result.

soundness_flags.label: ass:covariate-design and ass:holder-nuisances
soundness_flags.one_line: ChernozhukovEtAl2018DML supplies generic orthogonal-score/cross-fitting theory, not the stated bounded-density Hölder-sieve learning theorem; cite a nonparametric series-rate source or label these as explicit sieve regularity conditions.

soundness_flags.label: lem:lf-membership
soundness_flags.one_line: Its prose premise is only ass:rate-compatibility although membership in M_n also requires the rare-event bound on d_n; state ass:rare-event explicitly in the implication.

soundness_flags.label: thm:gaussian-recovery
soundness_flags.one_line: Uniform coverage is a conclusion about a confidence set and does not imply a CLT; state the primitive iid, nuisance-drift, envelope, and variance conditions directly rather than using thm:uniform-coverage as the operative hypothesis.

soundness_flags.label: def:poisson-calibration-handle / Open-ended Question adaptive Poisson calibration
soundness_flags.one_line: The marked process retains only A=1,Y=1 observations, but the PN score also has rare control-arm residual contributions (notably A=0,Y=1); specify a full score-bearing marked process or prove why the omitted marks are ancillary.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem diameter lower bound
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The converse is only established on the explicit covariate-homogeneous least-favorable submodel.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The lower rate applies conditionally to every procedure honest over a model class containing that least-favorable submodel; it is not yet a sharp lower theorem for a broader covariate-rich class.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add Cuellar and Kennedy (2020) and state a precise separation: their projected conditional-PC regular confidence intervals versus the marginal PN triangular-array regime with nd_n allowed bounded.

Replace the guard-free diameter OEQ with a named candidate, such as full score-cell conditional Poisson likelihood-ratio inversion, and formulate its target as a matching honest-diameter theorem against thm:diameter-lower.

Rewrite Gaussian recovery from primitive triangular-array and cross-fit remainder conditions, then prove that its influence function algebraically equals the Tian--Wu monotone-PN EIF when d_n is bounded below.

Build the adaptive calibration from a joint marked process for every score-bearing A,Y cell and give a finite-effective-count calibration/coverage route; this can turn the currently conservative guarded procedure into a matched frontier result.

recommended_next_step: Continue revision: repair the score-process specification and Gaussian theorem assumptions, correct the assumption citations, and sharpen the guard-free frontier around a concrete Poisson-inversion construction before Stage 0.
